name: Tesla Model Y All-Weather Interior Liners
fit: Model Y 2025+ (refresh / "Juniper"), excluding Model Y L
forWho: Owners who want the factory option with raised walls for snow, mud, and spills.
note: Tesla's own TPE liners: driver, passenger, and second-row pieces with integrated cleats. Tesla Shop may require signing in with a Tesla account tied to your vehicle, and stock comes and goes.
imageAlt: Tesla Model Y All-Weather Interior Liners (product photo from Tesla Shop)

name: 3D MAXpider KAGU Floor Mats (Model Y 2021–2024, 5-seat)
fit: Model Y 5-seat 2021–2024 (per this Amazon listing). Separate versions exist for 2020, 7-seat, and the refreshed Juniper Model Y
forWho: Owners who want a lighter, quieter mat than hard rubber.
note: Three layers: a rubber top, a foam core, and an anti-skid backing, so it's lighter and quieter than hard rubber trays. Rated 4.7★ by 800+ Amazon buyers. Pick the right style on the Amazon page: 2020 cars and the 2026 "Juniper" refresh have their own KAGU versions.
imageAlt: 3D MAXpider KAGU Floor Mats (Model Y 2021–2024, 5-seat) (product photo from Amazon)

name: Tesla Universal Wall Connector
fit: All Model Y (charges any EV through the built-in J1772 adapter)
forWho: Owners with a garage or driveway who want fast, reliable home charging.
note: Up to 48 A (11.5 kW, about 44 miles of range per hour) on a 60 A circuit. Model Y Long Range and Performance can use the full 48 A, while some Model Y RWD and AWD trims max out at 32 A (7.7 kW). Tap the lightning-bolt icon on your touchscreen to check yours before you size the breaker. It must be installed by a qualified electrician, and installation costs vary a lot by home.
imageAlt: Tesla Universal Wall Connector (product photo from Tesla Shop)

name: Spigen Sliding Console Organizer with Bottle Holder
fit: Model Y 2025+ ("Juniper")
forWho: Refresh owners who carry a big 32–40 oz water bottle.
note: A sliding tray with an angled bottle holder and a sunglasses slot. Spigen says it fits 32 oz and 40 oz bottles.
imageAlt: Spigen Sliding Console Organizer with Bottle Holder (product photo from Spigen)

name: Abstract Ocean Ultra-Bright Interior Light Bundles
fit: This link: 2025+ "Juniper". For 2020–2024 "Classic" Model Y, use the Classic bundle (linked at the top of the product page).
forWho: Owners who find the stock footwell, trunk, or frunk lights too dim.
note: Plug-in LED bulbs that replace the stock footwell, door, trunk, and frunk lights. Abstract Ocean says they're 16× brighter at 2× the current, and they come with extension leads and a trim tool. Swapping them takes about 30 minutes. The Classic bundle is a separate product: https://www.abstractocean.com/products/ultra-bright-light-bundle-tesla-model-y
imageAlt: Abstract Ocean Ultra-Bright Interior Light Bundles (product photo from Abstract Ocean)

name: BASENOR Model Y Juniper Roof Sunshade
fit: Model Y 2025–2026 ("Juniper") only
forWho: Refresh owners who want a near-blackout roof shade.
note: Foldable shade with clip-in install. BASENOR states it does not fit 2020–2024 cars. Its heat-reduction figures are the maker's own claims.
imageAlt: BASENOR Model Y Juniper Roof Sunshade (product photo from BASENOR)

name: Tesla Model Y All-Weather Rear Trunk + Seatback Liner
fit: Model Y 2025+ (5-seat, Premium/Performance, and 7-seat versions), excluding Model Y L
forWho: People hauling dogs, sports gear, or groceries who fold the rear seats a lot.
note: Trunk liner plus seatback liners that cover the backs of the folded second row. Choose the version that matches your seat configuration.
imageAlt: Tesla Model Y All-Weather Rear Trunk + Seatback Liner (product photo from Tesla Shop)

name: Hansshow Roof Rack Crossbars (Model Y 2020+, incl. Juniper)
fit: Model Y 2020–Feb 2025 and 2025+ "Juniper" (one version fits both, per Hansshow)
forWho: Bikers, skiers, and campers who need roof carrying capacity.
note: No-drill crossbars with T-slots. Roof racks cut range at highway speed, so many owners take them off when they're not in use. Check the listed load rating against your roof box or tent.
imageAlt: Hansshow Roof Rack Crossbars (product photo from Hansshow)

name: TuxMat Custom Floor Mats: Model Y 5-Seater AWD
fit: Model Y 5-seat AWD, 2026–2027 (refreshed body) per TuxMat. RWD, 7-seat, and older Model Y have separate TuxMat listings, so pick yours before ordering.
forWho: Owners who want the most footwell and sidewall coverage and don't mind a thicker, rubbery feel.
note: Laser-measured mats that go high up the sidewalls. Optional trunk, frunk, and sub-trunk pieces are listed separately on the same page.
imageAlt: TuxMat Custom Floor Mats: Model Y 5-Seater AWD (product photo from TuxMat)

name: Spigen Sliding Center Console Organizer Upper Tray
fit: Model Y 2021–2024 (also Model 3 2021–2023)
forWho: Pre-refresh owners tired of loose items in the deep center console.
note: A polycarbonate tray that slides to give you access to the lower console. Not for the 2025+ refreshed console.
imageAlt: Spigen Sliding Center Console Organizer Upper Tray (product photo from Spigen)

name: Tesla Model Y Sunshades (Glass Roof / Rear Liftgate)
fit: Model Y 2020–2024
forWho: Owners in hot or sunny climates whose rear passengers bake under the glass roof.
note: Tesla's own mesh shades on a collapsible frame. Tesla says the roof shade blocks 66% of luminous transmittance. They come with a zippered storage pouch.
imageAlt: Tesla Model Y glass roof sunshade (2020–2024), product photo from Tesla Shop

name: Abstract Ocean Premium Mud Flaps for Refreshed Model Y
fit: Model Y 2025+ ("Juniper"). Not for Model Y L.
forWho: Refresh owners who want mud flaps from a Tesla-focused shop.
note: A set of four flexible flaps with a screwless install (Tesla's own set is sold in pairs). Classic 2020–2024 owners need Abstract Ocean's separate "Premium Model 3 & Y Mud Flaps". Some owners say flaps slightly change the look and add a little noise.
imageAlt: Abstract Ocean Premium Mud Flaps for Refreshed Model Y (product photo from Abstract Ocean)

name: WeatherTech FloorLiner / FloorLiner HP
fit: Model Y (choose your model year in WeatherTech's vehicle selector)
forWho: People who want a well-known US brand with a guaranteed-fit policy.
note: Rigid, tray-style liners that catch slush and salt. The HP version is softer and grippier. WeatherTech's Model Y page also lists cargo liners and mud flaps.
imageAlt: WeatherTech FloorLiner / FloorLiner HP (product photo from WeatherTech)

name: LinerX Rear Trunk Mat (+ optional Trunk Well Liner)
fit: Model Y 2020–2025, 5-seat (LinerX's label; confirm with LinerX for a 2025+ "Juniper" refresh)
forWho: Owners who want to cover both the main trunk floor and the sub-trunk well.
note: The main trunk mat comes with or without ear-flaps that cover the folded seatbacks. The sub-trunk well liner is a separate product that's linked from the mat's page.
imageAlt: LinerX Rear Trunk Mat (product photo from LinerX)

name: LinerX Front Trunk (Frunk) Liner
fit: Model Y 2020–2025 (LinerX's label). LinerX doesn't say whether the 2025+ "Juniper" refresh is covered, so confirm with LinerX before ordering for a refreshed car.
forWho: Anyone who puts wet, dirty, or leaky things in the frunk.
note: A custom-fit tray for the frunk tub. The frunk is a common place for spills that are hard to clean.
imageAlt: LinerX Front Trunk (Frunk) Liner (product photo from LinerX)

name: RPM Tesla Model Y Sub-Trunk Dual Level Organizer
fit: Model Y 2020–2025 (per RPM listing)
forWho: Owners who want to use the deep sub-trunk well without everything piling up.
note: A two-layer insert that splits the deep sub-trunk well into a top tray and a bottom bin, so small items don't get buried under bags. RPM lists it for 2020–2025; confirm before ordering for a 2025+ "Juniper" refresh.
imageAlt: RPM Tesla Model Y Sub-Trunk Dual Level Organizer (product photo from RPM Tesla)

name: JOWUA Center Console Tray Organizer (Model Y 2021–2024)
fit: Model Y 2021–2024 and Model 3 2021–2023 (JOWUA calls this the "refreshed console"). Separate JOWUA version for the 2020 Model Y console. Does not fit the 2025+ "Juniper" Model Y.
forWho: Owners who want a clean OEM-style tray to organize the console.
note: A silicone-lined tray that drops into the deep front console so loose items don't slide around. It comes in 2- or 3-compartment versions and works with JOWUA's USB-C hubs. Watch out: JOWUA's "refreshed" label means the 2021 console, not the 2025 Juniper.
imageAlt: JOWUA Center Console Tray Organizer (Model Y 2021–2024) (product photo from JOWUA)

name: EcoNour Windshield Sun Shade for Model 3 & Y
fit: Model Y and Model 3, 2017–2026 (per EcoNour listing)
forWho: Owners who park outside in summer and want a cooler cabin and steering wheel for very little money.
note: A foldable reflective shade for the windshield that comes with a storage pouch. EcoNour lists one size for Model 3 and Model Y, 2017–2026. It doesn't cover the glass roof, so pair it with a roof shade if rear passengers complain.
imageAlt: EcoNour Windshield Sun Shade for Model 3 & Y (product photo from EcoNour)

name: JOWUA Tempered Glass Screen Protector
fit: Pre-refresh Model Y 2020–2024 / Model 3 2017–2023 15-inch screen (per JOWUA's collections). Not for the 2025+ "Juniper" screen.
forWho: Owners who want to keep the touchscreen from getting scratched, especially with kids or keys around.
note: Edge-to-edge tempered glass that protects the center screen from scratches and makes fingerprints easier to wipe off. It's a clear finish, so it won't cut glare much.
imageAlt: JOWUA Tempered Glass Screen Protector (product photo from JOWUA)

name: WeatherTech No-Drill MudFlaps
fit: 2026 Model Y (Base, Premium, Performance), part 110226-120226. Use WeatherTech's selector for other years.
forWho: Drivers on gravel or winter-salt roads who want to cut rock chips on the rocker panels.
note: No-drill design that mounts to existing fender hardware. Mud flaps change the car's look a bit, and some owners report a small aero or noise trade-off. Availability varies: weathertech.com may show "coming soon" while retailers carry part 110226-120226.
imageAlt: WeatherTech No-Drill MudFlaps (product photo from WeatherTech)

name: Husky Liners WeatherBeater Cargo Liner (Model Y 2020–2024)
fit: Model Y 2020–2024, pre-refresh (part 25211HUL; some retailers also list early-2025 pre-refresh cars). Not listed for the 2025+ "Juniper" refresh.
forWho: Owners who want a stiff, US-made cargo tray that holds up to boots, tools, and dog crates.
note: Laser-measured liner for the main cargo floor behind the second row, with a raised edge to hold spills and small nibs underneath so it doesn't slide. It's firmer than Tesla's or LinerX's rubber liners. It doesn't cover the folded seatbacks or the sub-trunk.
imageAlt: Husky Liners WeatherBeater Cargo Liner (Model Y 2020–2024) (product photo from Husky Liners)
